auditor.role: independent translation auditor (team lopdev); authored no catalogue value
auditor.model_provenance: Harness-reported model for this session is radient/auto. The upstream provider/model id is not exposed to the session, so it is not named. No model fallback occurred during this run.
auditor.independence: Different agent and session from the translator (translation-auditor vs i18n-translator, session a551a85b0a2f vs c30ee3949549). This session authored no catalogue value in the batch and did not edit any catalogue file; every quoted value was read from the bytes at the audited head.

translator.receipt_verified: Its per-namespace en/ru/context SHA-256 values were recomputed from the bytes at the audited head and all 45 matched.

scope: All 15 ui.chat.* namespaces carried by ru at 5829c3ca54bfdc13e802e30cda0738a04011db78: 1,795 Russian values read against the English source and the English context sidecar. 1,765 values are new in this branch (git diff against 5d97575ac4388522267291ffee74d12bd9675b12: 0 changed, 1,765 added); the 30 carried values (ui.chat 8, ui.chat.header 10, ui.chat.asks 12) are byte-identical to the base and were read for register and glossary continuity. Key coverage against English: 0 missing, 0 extra. Translated catalogue files only: test files and the translator receipt added by the branch were not reviewed as catalogue copy.
method: Read every ru value beside its English source and the context sidecar (role, tone, length, note, placeholders) at the audited head.
Parsed all 1,795 pairs with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser and compared argument names, number/date skeletons, tag names, select option sets and pound nodes.
Rendered every ru message through intl-messageformat at 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 11, 21, 22, 25, 101 and 1.5 to exercise every plural arm and catch branch errors.
Checked the ru CLDR category set (one/few/many/other) on all 45 plural messages and read agreement arm by arm at 1, 2-4, 5-20 and fraction counts.
Compared number-token presence per arm: no arm where English shows # and ru drops it.
Byte-compared en and ru; every exact match is listed per namespace and classified.
Checked NFC, manual bidi controls (U+202A-202E, U+2066-2069, U+200E/F, U+061C) and C0/C1 controls.
Checked the 9 advisory maxCells budgets and ranked every non-plural value by length against its English source.

Read the call sites where meaning depended on composition: the approval typed-answer resolver, the message-budget size formatter, the run-details pane name, the fleet ask toast, the directory picker, the unset-setting button row, the identity-menu quote fragment, the composer suggestion pool (user-to-agent prompts) and the wake-due formatter.
Re-derived every namespace block through scripts/i18n/ledger-rules.mjs deriveReceiptAudit against the bytes on disk, so the receipt is machine-checkable.

english.ui.chat.chat_page.reply_yes_or_no_to_ans: Reply yes or no to answer the approval request.

current.ui.chat.chat_page.reply_yes_or_no_to_ans: Ответьте «да» или «нет», чтобы ответить на запрос одобрения.

findings.proposed: Ответьте yes или no, чтобы ответить на запрос одобрения.
findings.reason: The copy tells the reader to type «да»/«нет», but approval-words.ts approvalAnswerValue accepts only y/yes/approve/ok/allow, n/no/deny/reject/cancel and the ordinals 1/2. chat-page.tsx throws this very sentence when a typed answer is not recognised, so a ru reader who follows it types «да» and gets the same refusal again. The batch keeps these tokens Latin in trace/question_dock.answer_from_the_composer_instead and question_dock.choose_approve_or_deny_above (yes, no, 1, 2), so this key is also the inconsistent one. Fix in copy (keep the literal input tokens Latin) or teach the parser the localized words in code.

findings.proposed: … — больше, чем вмещает одно сообщение ({limit}). … (одна команда / один агент in the matching keys). Example: «Эти изображения вместе весят {size} — больше, чем вмещает одно сообщение ({limit}). Удалите изображение или отправьте их во втором сообщении.»
findings.reason: The relative «которые» has no plural antecedent: {limit}/{value2} is a formatted byte size («1,5 МБ») or a bare character count. findings.reason: The pane's name in this locale is «сведения о выполнении» (ten uses). These two menu rows drop the qualifier, so the row no longer says which details it closes. Constraint recorded: the sidecar's advisory maxCells is 20 and the full term is 28 cells, so if the budget is real this is a width decision to take deliberately (and record), not a translation slip.

findings.reason: Russian prose uses «ёлочки», but this fragment opens a Latin curly quote while chat-header-identity-menu.tsx hard-codes the closing ” in JSX. Fixing only the catalogue would produce mismatched quotes, so the fix is a source change (make the closing glyph a key or a locale-aware pair); recorded against this key because that is where the opener lives.

english.ui.chat.run_details.run_child_reader.thi: This subagent has no transcript on disk yet.

findings.proposed: У этого субагента пока нет транскрипта на диске.
findings.reason: Same transcript drift as R1-03/R1-05: the style guide's recorded term is «транскрипт», this string says «расшифровка».

findings.proposed: Отменить пробуждение, запланированное на {dueLabel}
findings.reason: {dueLabel} is formatWakeDue output: a clock time, optionally with a date («3:05 PM», «10 окт. 2026 г. 3:05 PM»). «сработает {dueLabel}» needs a preposition for a time and none works for both shapes; «запланированное на» reads correctly for both. Note the call site also formats that label in English (AM/PM, English month names) — a code-side localisation gap outside this receipt's scope.

findings.proposed: «база расчёта недоступна»; «без отслеживаемой базы расчёта»; «{marked} без отслеживаемой базы расчёта{children}»
findings.reason: Here basis is the cost basis (the key family is session_cost). «Основа» is the abstract foundation and reads as nonsense beside «расходы»/«стоимость»; the cost panel needs «база расчёта» (or «основание расчёта»).

findings.reason: One sentence refers to the same thing twice with two genders: «запустить его» (masculine) then «откройте её» (feminine). The nearest noun is «копия», so the first pronoun has no antecedent; naming the conversation fixes both.

findings.proposed: «…не показывается в транскрипте.»; «…и в их транскрипте сообщения пока нет…»; «…и сообщения нет в их транскрипте.»
findings.reason: Same transcript drift as R1-03/R1-04: three more «расшифровка» uses where the binding locale call is «транскрипт».

findings.proposed: Активировал panic / Активирует panic (или «включил режим panic»)
findings.reason: «Поднял панику» is the idiom for raising a fuss and names an emotional reaction, not the mesh panic command this row reports. The action is destructive, so the row should name the control: keep the command token Latin (as the glossary does for merge/pull/push) or say «режим panic».

findings.proposed: Заглянул / Заглядывает / Заглянул в сессию / Заглядывает в сессию
findings.reason: «Подсмотрел» means to spy or peep furtively; the tool row reports a read-only peek at a session. «Заглянуть» keeps the light-touch sense without the covert one.

findings.proposed: Снял консоль / Снимает консоль
findings.reason: «Захватил консоль» reads as seizing or taking over the console. The action captures its output (a screenshot/read), which Russian expresses with «снять».

findings.proposed: Показал предпросмотр переименования / Показывает предпросмотр переименования
findings.reason: «Предпросмотрел» is a made-up verb; the noun «предпросмотр» is established in the corpus (core ru uses «предпросмотр» throughout).

findings.proposed: 1 — ответить / 1-{value, number, ::group-off} — ответить
findings.reason: A keyboard hint built as «1 для ответа» reads as a purpose (1 for an answer) rather than a key that answers; the dash states the action.

verdict: changes_requested: 0 blocker, 5 major entries covering 3 distinct defects (the approval typed-answer tokens; the nine message-budget sentences; the transcript term split across canonical, run_details and trace), 8 minor and 10 nit. Eleven namespaces pass with only minors/nits; ui.chat, ui.chat.canonical, ui.chat.run_details and ui.chat.trace cannot back an audited row until the majors are fixed and re-audited.
